title: The Fee Taken In for Putting a Circle Membership's Standing Right
content:
## The fee for putting a Circle membership's standing right

One fee for putting the standing right is taken into a dues settlement on a Northbeam Circle Membership,
and which one it is follows the lapse day on the record, the standing of the membership and the late fee
entries the ledger already carries.

1. Where the membership record carries a lapse day and that day falls within the reinstatement window of
   the tier, the reinstatement fee of the tier is taken in.
2. Where the membership stands in grace, the record carries no lapse day inside the reinstatement window of
   the tier, and the ledger carries an earlier late fee entry booked in the twelve months ending on the
   handling day, the repeat late fee of this schedule, 18.00, is taken in.
3. Where the membership stands in grace, the record carries no lapse day inside that reinstatement window,
   and the ledger carries no earlier late fee entry in the twelve months ending on the handling day, the
   late fee figure of the tier is taken in.
4. Where none of those holds, no fee for putting the standing right is taken in, and 0.00 goes into the
   settlement on this account.

## The tier figures the readings turn on

| Tier | Reinstatement fee (USD) | Late dues fee (USD) | Reinstatement window (days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Circle Plus Annual | 10.00 | 5.00 | 60 |
| Circle Total Annual | 20.00 | 9.00 | 90 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 20.00 | 9.00 | 90 |
| Circle Business Pro | 50.00 | 25.00 | 120 |
| Circle Business Elite | 75.00 | 40.00 | 180 |

The repeat late fee of this schedule stands at 18.00 whatever the tier.

## Cases on the four readings

A membership lapsed 40 days ago on Circle Plus Annual, whose reinstatement window is 60 days, carries a
lapse day inside that window, so the reinstatement fee of 10.00 is the fee taken in — the late fee
entries on the ledger make no difference to that reading.

A membership standing in grace on Circle Business Elite with no lapse day on the record and one late fee
entry booked seven months ago takes in the repeat late fee of 18.00 rather than that tier's late dues fee of
40.00. With no such entry inside the twelve months, the same membership would take in 40.00.

A membership standing active, with no lapse day on the record, falls to the fourth reading: nothing is
taken in for putting the standing right.
